rows: I haven't done everything yet. That is not the same as saying I can't.
Brawling? Yeah, I'm learning. I try to do it carefully.
Risk? I'm not sure yet. I want to learn how to judge them first.
Time, to me, is good. I'm still working on the timing.
The people deserve a proper match. I am going to try my very best to give them one.
I'm learning, and I'm here, and I want to show you what I've got.
I am not an expert yet. I am working towards being someone people can trust in big matches.
I am checking my stance, and learning. I practised it. I still wobble sometimes, but I'm getting there.
Technique, I am still learning it. I am still learning mine. Could you show me yours, please?
Strikes are part of the job. I'm learning which ones to throw and when.
The gamble is worth it if you learn from it. I want to learn from mine.
A stall is not something I am trying to do. I'd rather keep learning.
The people want a big match. I want to give them one, even if I am still learning.
You say I'm not ready. Maybe. Give me a test and I will show you.
That pride in your {strength}: great. That's great. I'm still working out what mine is.
I have been trying to understand your {strength}. I'll be honest, it's a lot to learn.
You are calm, and I am learning from that. Good, then. I'm still working on that one.
Fair, I am learning from that. You're right, and I'm going to learn from that.
I could get upset about that. I'm trying not to. I'm trying to learn.
One fall, and I hope it stays simple. Keep me down, and I will be really pleased. Honestly.
On the mat I'll try to stay steady. I want to show you I can.
Grounded or standing, I'll do my best. That's all I can promise.
Stand up, and I will learn from you. Give me a chance to show you what I've learned.
That was a good answer to learn from. I'm going to remember that one.
You haven't answered yet. I'll wait. I'm a patient learner.
Fair, I am learning from that. I'll take that as a test.
I concede that, and I am learning it. Let's see how it goes at the bell.
I will give this match everything I have, and I will learn as I go.
My approach is careful. I am still learning, and I will do my best.
Whatever happens, I want to learn from it.
Still going. I still have more to learn.
I have one more thing to try, and you will see it when the bell rings.
Oh, fair enough. I haven't got a real example to show you. I shouldn't have said it like that.
I'm still learning when to keep my mouth shut. I can't prove that one, so I'll take it back.
That's a good correction. We can both learn more from wrestling than arguing about that.
Thanks for clearing that up. I'm ready to see how we get on in the ring.
I'd like them to see if I can stay calm when you catch me in a hold. I've been trying to learn that.
We can find out how much I've improved by wrestling each other. I don't want to pretend I know the answer already.
